name: Signuply AI Chat – AI Chatbot & Live Chat for Lead Generation
author: signuply

sections.description:
Businesses lose potential customers every day because website visitors don’t get an instant response. Contact forms are slow, emails are delayed, and many visitors leave before anyone follows up.

Signuply AI Chat adds an AI chatbot and live chat widget to your WordPress site that responds to visitors immediately — even outside business hours. The AI assistant answers customer questions, asks qualifying questions, captures contact details, and detects when a lead is ready for follow-up. No coding required.

Unlike a simple contact form or a generic chatbot, Signuply is built for lead generation: every conversation is analyzed, summarized, and classified — so you follow up with the right people at the right time.

Note: This plugin requires a Signuply account to function. A free plan is available.

How it works:

  1. Install the plugin and create an account (or connect an existing one) — no coding required.
  2. Configure your assistant: set your goals, qualifying questions, and system prompt using the Signuply dashboard.
  3. Visitors get instant answers and guided conversations around the clock.
  4. See conversations, detected leads, hot opportunities, and contact details all in one place.

Key features:

  • 24/7 AI chat support — respond to visitors immediately, even after hours.
  • Lead qualification — classify leads as cold, warm, or hot based on intent and conversation signals.
  • Lead capture — collect email, phone number, or name naturally during the chat.
  • Train the AI on your content — use website pages and files as context for accurate, business-specific answers.
  • AI conversation summaries — see what matters without reading full transcripts.
  • Speed-to-lead alerts — trigger email or SMS the moment a hot lead is detected.
  • Multi-site support — run separate assistants across multiple websites (Business plan).

Your team spends time only on conversations with real potential — not reviewing dozens of generic chats.

Who is it for?

Signuply AI Chat works best for businesses where a fast first response wins the customer:

  • Service businesses (legal, financial, home services, healthcare)
  • Language schools, courses, and education providers
  • Agencies and freelancers (also as a white-label service for clients)
  • Local businesses that can’t answer the phone or chat all day

Plugin features:

  • Create or connect a Signuply account directly from WordPress.
  • Dual-key security: public key (wgt_) for the widget, private key (wsk_) for settings — never exposed in page source.
  • Sync widget appearance with the Signuply dashboard (title, color, position, welcome message, avatar, privacy policy URL).
  • Local display rules: show/hide the chat widget on specific pages or filter by device type.
  • Lightweight widget that won’t slow down your site.
  • Clean uninstall removes all stored data.

Learn more at signuply.io/chat.

External Services

This plugin connects to the external Signuply service to provide AI chat functionality.

Service URL:
https://chat-app.signuply.io

The plugin sends the following data:
– Website URL
– Chat configuration settings
– End-user messages submitted through the chat widget

This data is used to:
– Generate AI responses
– Detect and qualify leads
– Provide conversation history and analytics

Terms of Service:
https://signuply.io/legal/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://signuply.io/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the signuply-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Follow the onboarding wizard: create a new Signuply account or connect an existing one with your public (wgt_) and private (wsk_) keys.
  4. Configure your AI assistant in the Signuply dashboard.
  5. Adjust widget appearance and display rules from the plugin settings page.

No coding required — just activate and go.
sections.faq:
Is there a free plan?

Yes. The Free plan includes a limited number of AI conversations per month — enough to test the chatbot on a live site. Paid plans add more conversations, lead alerts, and multi-site support.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

No key is required to start. The Free plan includes a limited number of conversations; after reaching this limit, you can provide your own OpenAI key, which is used via Signuply services. Standard and Business plans include conversations without a separate key.

Will the chat widget slow down my website?

No. The widget is loaded asynchronously and does not block page rendering, so your Core Web Vitals are not affected.

Does it work with my theme and page builder?

Yes. The widget is theme-independent and works with any properly coded WordPress theme, including sites built with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and other page builders.

Can the assistant use my website content for answers?

Yes. In higher plans, your AI assistant can use selected website pages and files as context to answer visitors more accurately — FAQs, service pages, pricing details, and more.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. You can display your own privacy policy link in the widget, conversation data is processed according to our privacy policy, and a clean uninstall removes all data stored by the plugin. See the External Services section for details on what data is sent.

What is the difference between wgt_ and wsk_ keys?

The wgt_ key is your public widget key — it loads the chat widget on your site. The wsk_ key is your private key — it stays on the server and is used to manage widget settings via the API. The private key is never exposed to visitors.

Can I use it on multiple websites?

The Business plan supports multiple websites with separate assistants for each.

What happens when a hot lead is detected?

Signuply can trigger email or SMS actions automatically when a high-intent conversation is detected, so you can follow up while the lead is still on your site.

Is professional setup available?

Yes. Add professional setup to any plan for +$99. The Signuply team will configure everything for you within 48 hours.
